correctness.rationale: With \(c_n=1\) for even \(n\) and \(c_n=\cos(\pi/n)\) for odd \(n\), the comparison kernel \(h=(4c_n-1)1_U-1_{2U}\) has the exact decomposition \(h=\sigma+\tau\), \(\sigma=(6c_n-4)(\delta_1+\delta_{-1})\ge0\), and \(\widehat\tau(k)=4(1-x_k)(x_k+c_n)\ge0\) because every cyclic cosine satisfies \(-c_n\le x_k\le1\). This proves the upper bound. The explicit witness \(f_*(j)=(c_n+\cos(2\pi\lfloor n/2\rfloor j/n))/(1+c_n)\) is nonnegative and positive definite, has \(f_*(0)=1\), \(f_*(\pm1)=0\), \(f_*(\pm2)=2c_n-1\), and attains \(4c_n-1\).
